messages:
Anna L.: Quick pre-cutoff check — planning to cut v0.23.1 at 16:00 UTC. Is the version bump, changelog, and tag ready? Please call out any blockers. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Devon: Pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321 — bump + changelog. CI passed for unit tests, pending smoke.
Sophie: I'm on smoke tests. Seeing intermittent failure in cache eviction test. Re-running with increased timeout. Will report in 10m.
Kevin: Security review done — dependency audit (npm audit fix) ran, no high/severe. Linted for secrets. @Anna L. we should be good.
ReleaseBot: [automated] Release checklist: all PRs merged? tag created? smoke tests green? QA sign-off. Use `/release prepare v0.23.1` to lock.
Mike R.: Docs updated: upgrade-guide.md and changelog entry. Need a quick proofread for the upgrade note about KV caching behavior.
Anna L.: @Mike R. will skim now. @Devon can you create the annotated tag when smoke is green? Command we'd use:
```
git tag -a v0.23.1 -m "v0.23.1: bugfixes & docs"
git push origin v0.23.1
```
Devon: yep, will tag once Sophie gives the green. Approving PR now. :white_check_mark: 
Sophie: smoke is green after timeout bump — all services healthy, e2e running.
Devon: tag pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/releases/tag/v0.23.1
ReleaseBot: [automated] Release v0.23.1 recorded; rolling cut window closed. :ship: Congrats!
Anna L.: Thanks everyone. Post-cut: watch console for errors and run quick canary in prod namespace for 30m. I'll post checklist in #eng-sre.
